notes: modern_boxAF, form revision v. 12.23, masthead 'Aaron Davidson, Clerk'. SEVEN PDF PAGES, each classified from its own printed header and its own foliation box: p1 an ORIGINAL cover foliated 'Page 1', p2 an AMENDED cover also foliated 'Page 1', p3 'Schedule A' page 2, p4 'Schedule A' page 3, p5 'Schedule B' page 4, p6 'Schedule B' page 5, p7 'Summary Page' page 6. NO CHECKLIST bound. pdfinfo: 7 pages, all rot: 0. THIS IS ONE REPORT, NOT A TWO-REPORT BUNDLE — and that reading comes from the foliation and the schedules, not from the filename. The filer's own numbering runs 1,2,3,4,5,6 with TWO sheets numbered 1: there is a single Schedule A (two sheets), a single Schedule B (two sheets) and a single Summary Page, so the second cover REPLACES the first rather than opening a second report. `report_index` is therefore deliberately NOT set and nothing was split. WHAT THE TWO COVERS SAY: p1 is the ORIGINAL — amendment question ticked NO, report type ticked 'Seven days preceding the General Election', signed Oct. 23 2024, Date of Report Oct. 24 2024, clerk RECEIVED stamp OCT 23 2024 (stamped twice, once across the report-type block and once in the Office-Use box). p2 is the AMENDMENT — amendment ticked YES with 'Date of Original Report Oct. 23 2024' written in, signed Oct. 23 2024 but Date of Report Oct. 25 2024, RECEIVED OCT 25 2024 'BY: Brian Voeks'. ⚠ ON THE AMENDED COVER NO REPORT-TYPE RADIO IS TICKED AT ALL — an honest BLANK, never read as any particular type; the original cover's 'Seven days preceding the General Election' is recorded as what THAT sheet prints and was not transferred onto the amendment. WHAT THE AMENDMENT APPEARS TO HAVE ADDED: the three sheets dated Oct 23 2024 (pp3/4/5) all print the grand totals 10,391.30, which can only be reached by including PDF p6 — the Schedule B sheet dated Oct. 25 2024, carrying the 4/12-5/9 rows including the two largest expenditures (3,152.84 and 5,471.41). So the ledger sheets and the grand totals are internally consistent with each other while the sheet DATES are not; both are recorded, neither adjudicated. THE L2 SCREEN MATTERED HERE: both schedules run across a sheet break, and each sheet prints its OWN subtotal, so each sheet was gated on its own subtotal AND the pair gated against the grand total — reconciling either first sheet alone would have manufactured a phantom shortfall. SUMMARY BOXES CROSS-CHECKED AGAINST THE SHEET HEADINGS (L1 screen): the Schedule A grand total lands in Box B and the Schedule B grand total in Box D — no swap, and the coincidence that the two sides are both 10,391.30 was checked against the sheet headings rather than assumed. Page-face candidate 'Burt Garfield' (index.csv 'Burt  Garfield', double space only). Page-face Office box reads 'County Assessor' on the ORIGINAL cover and just 'Assessor' on the AMENDED cover — the filer's own two wordings, both recorded, agreeing with index.csv 'County Assessor'; no office was inferred. THE GARFIELD PAIR: the county also published '2024_Burt_Garfield_Redacted.pdf' (key 13c507cb). Each document is transcribed INDEPENDENTLY and on its own terms; nothing here was merged, netted or differenced against it, and the kind-classification of the pair is set out in both records' notes. PRIVACY: the county blacked out the candidate's street address, phone number and signature on BOTH covers. The donor side needed no reduction — the filer wrote city/state/zip only and no street line appears anywhere on either Schedule A sheet.
